items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Were you here for Buddy Petitia's funeral? [INTERVIEWEE] I was, yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: Oh I never played no good at big funerals. I had the opportunity to play at Papa Celestan Funerals but I was working at the time then you know. And I couldn't make it then. The General Chris Kelly Funerals was a big funeral too but we wasn't here at the time. We was in Greenville, Mississippi. The time Chris died, he had a big funeral up here.
Were you here for Buddy Petitia's funeral?
I was, yeah, yeah. But Buddy's funeral wasn't large as Chris would tell me. I was doing something like Papa Celestan.
